subject: Re: MAP & acceptance cadence for prompt-pack + test-suite transfer
messages:
From: Cara Morris <cara@novus-retail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jayesh Singh <j.singh@novus-retail.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & acceptance cadence for prompt-pack + test-suite transfer

Aditya / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the retrieval+rerank examples were helpful. Procurement asked me to confirm the operational steps to get a small evaluation run underway. We want to onboard the prompt-pack and ~6k test cases into an ephemeral sandbox (staging) for a 4-week QA window. Key asks from our side:

- A mutual action plan (MAP) that lists deliverables, acceptance gates and dates so our legal/procurement can sign off.
- Clear usage constraints: confirm we cannot redistribute the prompt-pack or benchmark dataset outside Novus; retention window after the test window; and approved personnel list.
- Access method (S3 presigned links or temporary GCP bucket) and an audit log to show who accessed what.

Can you draft the MAP and the minimal security checklist so we can share with our InfoSec and Procurement? Also, procurement will need an approximate invoice/PO line for the reserved sandbox.

Best,
Cara
Cara Morris
Director, Machine Intelligence
Novus Retail

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Morris <cara@novus-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance cadence for prompt-pack + test-suite transfer

Cara — thanks, glad the demo was useful. Attaching a first-draft MAP (Novus_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short playbook for the transfer. High level proposal:

1) Timeline & milestones
   - Day 0 (Nov 29): Redwood uploads prompt-pack and test-suite to an ephemeral staging bucket; provides S3 presigned URLs and a short instructions txt (attached).
   - Day 1–3: Novus performs smoke tests; lists any immediate redlines within 72 hours.
   - Day 4–14: QA window + evaluation runs (you said ~4 weeks total; we propose initial focused pass in first two weeks, then extended sampling).
   - Day 28 (Dec 27): Joint acceptance gate and results review.
   - Day 32: Redwood triggers data takedown (unless extended by written agreement).

2) Usage constraints (summary)
   - License: Novus may use the materials only for internal evaluation to inform purchasing decisions; no redistribution or inclusion in any commercial dataset.
   - Personnel: Access restricted to named Novus evaluators (we'll accept a roster).
   - Retention: Default 45 days after sandbox close unless Novus requests extension in writing; Redwood will delete artifacts and provide a deletion confirmation.
   - Auditability: Access logs (object GETs / presigned URL usage) retained for 90 days, shared on request.

3) Security controls
   - We propose presigned S3 links limited to IP ranges you provide, or temporary VPC-mounted bucket via your cloud account for higher assurance.
   - Encrypted-at-rest and in-transit; hashes for each bundle included.

4) Acceptance gates
   - Gate A (ingest/format): Novus confirms files are intact and runnable.
   - Gate B (smoke quality): Novus provides a short finding list; Redwood addresses major ingest issues within 3 business days.
   - Gate C (final acceptance): Joint sign-off on baseline metrics for the agreed suite or an escalation meeting to discuss variances.

I copied Laura from InfoSec to confirm the retention and auditing defaults; Monica will own the file delivery and presigned link rotation. Attaching: Novus_MAP_v1.pdf, promptpack-sample-list.csv, s3-presigned-access-instructions.txt (stubs).

Actions:
- Cara: confirm roster and whether you want IP whitelisting.
- Procurement: please advise PO cadence and billing contact (cc'd if helpful).

Thanks — Aditya

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Morris <cara@novus-retail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance cadence for prompt-pack + test-suite transfer

Hi Cara — quick InfoSec notes:

- Retention: Redwood standard for evaluation exchanges is 45 days post-acceptance, but for regulated partners we can extend to 90 days; extension requires a signed addendum.
- No-redistribution clause: we will include explicit language prohibiting inclusion in any model training or public dataset. Please expect a short addendum to the MAP with that clause.
- Audit logs: we will provide S3 access logs + CloudTrail events (where applicable) and a CSV summary of object GET operations tied to the provided user emails.
- Least privilege: we recommend presigned URLs with object-level TTLs (24–72 hrs) and rotation on reset. If you prefer a cross-account bucket, we can coordinate IAM roles for tighter control.

If Novus legal needs a template clause for the no-derivative/no-training restriction, we can draft one and send it back today. For now I recommend the default 45-day retention but we can accept Novus' request for 90 days if Procurement confirms.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
From: Cara Morris <cara@novus-retail.com>

Aditya / Laura — thank you, that plan is clear and addresses Procurement/InfoSec concerns. A few confirmations from our side before we sign:

- Retention: procurement can accept 45 days as default; Novus ML leadership will request a 90-day addendum if the evaluation uncovers a strong need.
- Personnel: we will send a roster of eight evaluators by Monday, Nov 30.
- Access method: we prefer presigned S3 links scoped to Novus IP ranges for the initial run. Please include rotation instructions.
- PO: procurement is preparing a PO for the reserved sandbox and "evaluation transfer" line item. Expect a PO number and contact (procurement@novus-retail.com) by Nov 30 EOD.

Please proceed with the Day 0 upload on Nov 29 as proposed. Once we have the PO and roster in place we will sign the MAP PDF and return it.

Best —
Cara

Attachments referenced in thread: Novus_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), promptpack-sample-list.csv (manifest stub), s3-presigned-access-instructions.txt (access steps).
